principle: Perspectival amplification through serial architectural framing multiplies depth perception by nesting concentric aperture reductions that function as optical levers, magnifying spatial recession beyond what single-point perspective mathematics alone would produce.

nodes.label: Single-point linear perspective with elevated vanishing point
nodes.description: All orthogonals converge at a point positioned at Plato's hand, creating unified spatial recession that organizes architectural and figural elements across the entire composition.
evidence: Vanishing point positioned at Plato's hand, approximately 60 percent up the vertical axis, dead center horizontally
All orthogonals (floor tiles, coffered vault ribs, architectural recessions) converge at one point
Compression ratio increases exponentially with distance: foreground occupies 40 percent of picture plane for 15 meters, background 10 percent for 30 meters
Stage 4 classifies as central mechanism with high confidence: removal collapses spatial coherence entirely

nodes.label: Nested architectural frames as perspectival amplifier
nodes.description: Three receding arches reduce sequentially in size (100/80/65 percent width), mechanically multiplying depth cues beyond what floor recession alone produces.
evidence: Quantified serial reduction: first arch spans full width, second 80 percent of first, third 65 percent of second
Stage 2 identifies frames as mechanical multipliers of the base spatial gradient set by floor recession
Stage 5 describes each frame as a perspectival echo chamber producing three synchronized recessions

nodes.label: Drapery as distributed tonal system
nodes.description: Each figure's fabric folds contain the full value range, making every figure a self-sufficient tonal unit that maintains local tonal completeness independent of surrounding figures.
evidence: Each figure's drapery contains highlight to shadow, creating local tonal completeness
Any single figure can be removed and the remaining composition retains tonal integrity
Stage 4 notes removal test requires inference about substitute tonal infrastructure, hence medium confidence
rule_violations: Compositional necessity: figures should be structurally indispensable

nodes.label: Vanishing point at Plato's hand
nodes.description: The single convergence point for all orthogonals, located dead center horizontally and roughly 60 percent up the vertical axis, between Plato and Aristotle.
evidence: Structural inventory locates the vanishing point at Plato's hand as the convergence of all orthogonals

nodes.label: Floor tile recession
nodes.description: Receding floor tile orthogonals that establish the base spatial gradient of the perspectival system.
evidence: Floor tile recession creates the base spatial gradient which the nested frames then multiply

nodes.label: Three serially reduced arches
nodes.description: Concrete architectural apertures reducing at 100, 80, and 65 percent widths, receding toward the vanishing point.
evidence: First arch spans full fresco width, second roughly 80 percent, third roughly 65 percent of the second
Stage 5 break test: removing the middle frame weakens the depth illusion while perspective remains

nodes.label: Discrete figure scale bands (200/160/80 cm)
nodes.description: Three stepped size bands corresponding to foreground, middle ground, and background depth planes, replacing gradual naturalistic diminution.
evidence: Foreground figures around 200 cm, middle ground around 160 cm, background around 80 cm
Stepped hierarchy rather than gradual recession; exaggeration is described as load-bearing
rules: Discrete scalar bands rather than gradual diminution

nodes.label: Void corridors between figure clusters
nodes.description: Negative space channels separating seven figure clusters, including a central corridor roughly 2.5 meters wide running unobstructed from foreground steps to background sky.
evidence: Voids preserve unobstructed sightlines to the vanishing point, preventing figural mass from occluding the perspectival system
Stage 2 calls voids verification infrastructure allowing continuous confirmation that orthogonals remain synchronized
Stage 4 rates as supporting: the system would function less clearly without them
rules: Void corridors preserve unobstructed sightlines to the vanishing point

nodes.label: Foreground platform of three steps
nodes.description: Steps at the composition's base, parallel to the picture plane with no perspectival recession, forming a threshold between viewer space and depicted space.
evidence: Steps are parallel to the picture plane, establishing a boundary condition prior to the perspectival system
Remove the threshold and the perspectival system extends to the picture plane edge, collapsing spatial hierarchy
Stage 3 notes the threshold zone remains functionally uninhabited
rule_violations: Threshold occupancy: the critical spatial transition zone should be inhabited

nodes.label: Asymmetric figure distribution (23 left, 29 right)
nodes.description: Figure placement deliberately violates the perfect axial symmetry of the architectural frame, preventing static heraldic balance.
evidence: 23 figures left, 29 figures right against a perfectly symmetric architectural frame
Stage 4 classifies the specific ratio as incidental: any asymmetric distribution would prevent heraldic stasis

nodes.label: Pigment layering economy for atmospheric perspective
nodes.description: Background figures executed in 1-2 pigment layers versus 3-4 in the foreground, letting intonaco white optically mix and reduce background tonal range to roughly 40 percent.
evidence: Foreground tonal range roughly 80 percent, background roughly 40 percent, achieved through material economy
Stage 4 rates as supporting and partly redundant with perspectival and scalar mechanisms

nodes.label: Giornata seams at figure contours
nodes.description: Daily plaster sections planned to terminate at figure contour edges so that no seam bisects a face or limb.
evidence: Seams visible under raking light at figure boundaries indicate each section was planned to end at contour edges
No seam bisects a form, producing structural integrity of each figure
rules: Giornata seams terminate at figure contour boundaries

nodes.label: Full-value-range drapery folds per figure
nodes.description: The concrete fabric folds on each figure that carry highlight through shadow, the physical substrate of the distributed tonal system.
evidence: Fabric folds carry the composition's tonal structure; each figure's drapery contains the full value range

nodes.label: Directional gesture vectors of key figures
nodes.description: Plato's vertical gesture, Aristotle's horizontal gesture, Pythagoras writing downward, Euclid's circular compass work, Heraclitus static: a pacing sequence guiding eye movement.
evidence: Vectors establish a repeatable pacing: vertical, horizontal, downward, circular, static
Stage 3: gestures of Plato and Aristotle immediately redirect attention away from the vanishing point convergence
rule_violations: Focal convergence: attention should terminate at the vanishing point

edges.rationale: The perspectival system is defined by the convergence of all orthogonals at the single point at Plato's hand; without it there is no unified recession.
Floor tile recession supplies the base spatial gradient that the perspectival system organizes; it is the primary orthogonal field.
Perspectival amplification requires serial architectural reduction; the mechanism is embodied in the three arches reducing at 100/80/65 percent widths.
Serial aperture reduction multiplies depth perception beyond baseline geometric recession; M1 survives without the frames but depth becomes weak and ambiguous.
The distributed tonal system is physically carried by the fabric folds; each figure's local tonal completeness exists only in its drapery.
Asymmetric figure distribution of 23 left and 29 right requires modular tonal autonomy to prevent compositional destabilization; each figure balances independently of the whole.
Void corridors preserve unobstructed sightlines to the vanishing point, letting the viewer continuously verify that orthogonals remain synchronized; verification rather than generation.

Discrete scalar bands of 200/160/80 cm exaggerate the perspectival depth gradient beyond optical accuracy, and prevent the gradual diminution that would expose the exaggeration of spatial compression.

The foreground platform parallel to the picture plane establishes the spatial threshold that all subsequent depth planes must negotiate; remove it and the tiered hierarchy collapses into continuous recession.

Atmospheric perspective through layering economy of 1-2 versus 3-4 layers reduces background tonal range to 40 percent, reinforcing recession; Stage 4 deems it redundant with perspectival and scalar mechanisms.
The tonal reduction must maintain internal tonal completeness in distant figures; this completeness is supplied by the drapery tonal system, yielding local autonomy within global recession.
Giornata seams terminating at figure contour boundaries prevent structural bisection of forms, warranting each figure's integrity as a self-sufficient tonal unit.

The perspectival system directs attention to the vanishing point between Plato and Aristotle, but their vertical and horizontal gestures immediately redirect attention away, undermining the focal convergence.

violated: Focal convergence: attention should terminate at the vanishing point

failure_modes.consequence: The perspectival infrastructure establishes a focal hierarchy that the focal figures refuse to occupy: Plato's gesture sends the eye upward outside the perspectival system and Aristotle's disperses it laterally, so the mechanism that concentrates focus is immediately undermined by the figures it elevates.

violated: Compositional necessity: figures should be structurally indispensable

failure_modes.consequence: Because every figure is a self-sufficient tonal unit, no figure is structurally indispensable; the 52-figure arrangement becomes arbitrary rather than inevitable, and the modularity that prevents collapse also prevents compositional necessity.

violated: Threshold occupancy: the critical spatial transition zone should be inhabited

failure_modes.consequence: The foreground platform organizes all subsequent spatial relationships yet remains functionally empty; the step figures have already crossed into perspectival space, leaving a void exactly where the most critical transition between viewer space and depicted space occurs.

Gradual diminution replaces discrete bands, allowing the viewer to calibrate perceived depth against the actual perspectival angle; the disproportionate depth illusion produced by serial framing is exposed as exaggeration.

Spatial coherence collapses entirely; the work becomes a collection of figures without unified spatial logic, and the amplifiers (frames, scalar bands, voids, atmospheric layering) have no baseline recession to multiply or verify.

Compositional modularity fails; the asymmetric distribution of 23 versus 29 figures destabilizes without local tonal autonomy, and atmospheric reduction can no longer maintain internal tonal completeness in background figures.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, spatial coherence collapses entirely and the work becomes a collection of figures without unified spatial logic.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, perspectival depth becomes weak and ambiguous, with floor recession alone insufficient to organize 52 figures across depicted 40+ meters.
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, compositional modularity fails and asymmetric distribution (23 vs 29 figures) destabilizes without local tonal autonomy.
